name: ModelVariant141_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant141_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a wavy background scrolls in and out, a tube grows from one of the slot's parts, sparks burst at their targets, beams spin between two parts joined by a bolt that flares at its middle, the screen flashes and ribbons and a cylinder spiral around the other slot); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the tube, sparks, beams and cylinder and packs eight texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the tube has grown, 4 until the fade-out time, 1 once when the fade-out starts, 2 once the flash time has passed and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-158 and 288 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x48 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
